## Code-plan review, round 8: renderer-only correction, both treatments

This is a code and board review only. I captured nothing, rendered nothing and made no pixel observations. A code pass approves no film. Both silent phone reviews, the timed phone review, the native hero and every final gate are still required.

**Verdicts**
- **Treatment A: pass.** The code addresses all six round-7 defects. No new blocking defect was found.
- **Treatment B: revise.** One blocking surface_finish defect: B's overhead creek view still draws the creek water as a hard-edged rectangle.

### Inputs and coverage
I read the following in full:
- the packet: /home/user/dispatch-editions/2026-10-19/TexasAIDispatch/out/dispatch/critic-packet-round8.json
- the brief, and all three changed sources:
  - /home/user/dispatch-editions/2026-10-19/TexasAIDispatch/video-engine/src/modern/episodes/2026-10-19/RobotaxiFilm.tsx (671 lines)
  - /home/user/dispatch-editions/2026-10-19/TexasAIDispatch/video-engine/src/modern/episodes/2026-10-19/RobotaxiHero.tsx
  - /home/user/dispatch-editions/2026-10-19/TexasAIDispatch/video-engine/src/modern/episodes/2026-10-19/SanAntonioSupport.tsx
- PlaceStage.tsx
- both complete boards, opening-a.json and opening-b.json (4632 lines each)
- report-a.json from round 7, claims.json, story_selection.json, openings/comparison.json and the episode registry
- the bound guides: MODERN_FILM, STORY_ART, AUTHORED_STORY_ART, ART_DIRECTION, the reference bank, viewer-plan, README, news-reporting, evidence-led-imagery and explanatory-animation (B's chosen approach), QUALITY_CONTRACT, DAILY_PRODUCTION, CREATIVE_DIRECTION, AUTONOMOUS_COMPLETION, claude_routine, AGENTS, scene-builder
- the configs: quality_contract, dispatch_rubric, modern_film, critic_concept_v2, art_direction, story_art, authored_story_art, autonomous_completion_v2, claude_runtime
- bounded excerpts of critic_gate.py, independent_review.py and daily_production.py

I did not read config/daily_production.json, config/creative_production.json or config/documentary.json.

**Hash checks**
- I have no Bash, so I recomputed no SHA256. I used your digests for concept, renderer and claims, and the packet's digests for everything else.
- The digests are consistent with each other:
  - The packet's board sha (2f529c7b…) equals opening-a's sha.
  - The board records RobotaxiHero as 3c05416f… and SanAntonioSupport as 0e59fd63…, which match the packet's asset_inputs. Its renderer_inputs list RobotaxiFilm as 52dac9b9….
  - The claims sha matches the board's story_art entries.
- Story digest: A uses the packet's c615cbc6…. **B's story digest was not supplied.** B's scenes and creative_direction differ from A's, so it needs its own gate-computed value. I left it null.
- **policy_sha256 is carried, not recomputed.** I copied the round-7 gate-bound value 01bff518…. The gate must confirm it against config/daily_production.json.
- I found no action_proposals in either board, so action_reviews is empty. I have reviewed the six authored story_art action uses separately.
